## Downloads

Choose the DMG for your Mac (Apple Silicon/ARM64 or Intel/x64), the Windows x64 installer or portable ZIP, or the Linux x64 AppImage/DEB. macOS 15+ and Ubuntu 24.04+ are the initial packaged-release baselines.

Mac applications are ad hoc signed and **not notarized**. Windows downloads are **not Authenticode signed**. See the [release and installation guide](https://github.com/ghillert/rust-commander/blob/v{{projectVersion}}/docs/RELEASING.md) for installation, first-launch approval, checksums, and known platform limitations.

The SHA-256 checksum file and release-manifest.json identify the complete asset set and source commit.
